signal: QuantHub rolled out new learning pathways in January 2026 and added UNC Kenan-Flagler professor Mark McNeilly to advise on its AI literacy strategy

email.body1:
Joe, saw QuantHub rolled out new learning pathways and brought on UNC's Mark McNeilly to guide your AI literacy strategy.

A push like that usually means a bigger pipeline target, with more enterprise and education accounts worth reaching than the team can cover before they go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for QuantHub off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Joe, quick follow-up for QuantHub.

As you broaden the offering, the target usually climbs faster than you can ramp reps. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings QuantHub needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Joe, last bit of proof for QuantHub.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. With our AI SDR they reached $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how QuantHub's reply rate likely compares to other B2B SaaS startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Joe, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Broadening the platform while running the team is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your sales motion? I will tailor it to QuantHub either way.
